# SQLite

> > SQLite is a self-contained, serverless, public domain SQL database engine written in C, widely used as an embedded database in applications worldwide.

SQLite is the most widely deployed database engine in the world, developed and maintained by D. Richard Hipp (drh) and the SQLite Consortium. The site also hosts documentation for Althttpd, a lightweight web server used to host sqlite.org itself, and utilizes Fossil for version control.

## Key Topics

- SQLite - embedded SQL database engine
- Self-contained database - no external dependencies
- Public domain - no licensing restrictions
- C-language implementation
- Serverless architecture
- SQL database engine
- Althttpd - lightweight HTTP server
- Fossil - distributed version control system
- SQLite Consortium - development sponsors
- Embedded database use cases
- C-library interface
- JSON support in SQLite
- TCL bindings and extensions

## Getting Started

- [SQLite Home Page](https://sqlite.org): Primary homepage for SQLite embedded SQL database engine
- [About SQLite](https://sqlite.org/about.html): Overview of SQLite serverless, self-contained database engine

## Althttpd Web Server

- [Althttpd Help](https://sqlite.org/althttpd/help): Command reference and CLI documentation for Althttpd/Fossil
- [Althttpd Setup Using Xinetd](https://www3.sqlite.org/althttpd/doc/trunk/xinetd.md): Guide for configuring Althttpd web server with Xinetd deployment
- [Althttpd Downloads](https://sqlite.org/althttpd/download): Download page for Althttpd source code and Fossil repository
- [Althttpd SSL Options](https://sqlite.org/althttpd/forumpost/b8139d20e60028ae): Discussion on SSL/TLS cipher suite configuration for Althttpd

## Community Support

- [Logfile Name Datetime Interpolation](https://sqlite.org/althttpd/forumpost/0e8dfd8d02bccd4a): Forum discussion on Althttpd logfile rotation datetime handling
- [HTTP Date Header Format Discussion](https://sqlite.org/althttpd/forumpost/1d76114162): Forum post about HTTP date header GMT format RFC compliance
- [Last-Modified Header Protocol Error](https://sqlite.org/althttpd/forumpost/3531e19567): Bug report on Last-modified header timezone issue in Alpine OS
